_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Civic Education Syllabus Grade 10-12' (2013, published by CDC) — Grade 10, Topics 10.1-10.7. Topic and Specific Outcome statements only; the 'Content' (Knowledge/Skills/Values) columns are omitted, consistent with the approach used for the other 2013 OBC subjects in this app, since they text-extract unreliably from the source's multi-column table. Unlike Geography, Grade 10's table has no separate 'Sub-topic' column populated — outcomes are numbered directly under each Topic — so each topic here is modeled with a single sub-topic bearing the same name as the topic, purely to satisfy this app's data schema, not because the source names a distinct sub-topic. Two genuine duplicate-numbering slips were found in the source document itself and corrected by renumbering sequentially from the point of duplication: under 10.6 Cultural Studies, outcome code 10.6.4 is printed twice for two different outcomes ('Discuss the importance of culture' and 'Explain types of culture'); under 10.7 Substance Abuse, outcome code 10.7.2 is printed twice ('Discuss substances and their effects' and 'Explain reasons for substance abuse'). The syllabus organizes content by Grade only, not by Term, so all of Grade 10 is modeled as a single term here.
